newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm, Yeltsin out of concern.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm, Yeltsin out of concern.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds firmed mainly on local short-covering in otherwise quiet trading, dealers said on Monday.

They said worries about President Boris Yeltsin's health had vanished after television showed him in an apparently satisfactory shape on Saturday during a one-day visit from German Chancellor Helmut Kohl.
Yeltsin will have a heart operation probably at the end of September in Moscow.
"Yeltsin looked more or less good so there has been no selling for this reason," one dealer said.

Some Russian banks had been buying the third, fourth and fifth tranches, seemingly to close short positions. But prices fell later after meeting resistance at 75.25-75.55, 48.25-48.55 and 31.40-31.70, respectively, dealers said.
They said a Western operator was buying the seventh tranche to meet a client investor order.
